gamerule.combat-penalty-remover.prevent_: If active, weapons (Swords, Axes, Bows, Crossbows) will not lose durability when attacking enemies.
If active, armor will not lose durability from combat-related damage (melee/ranged attacks).
If active, shields will not lose durability when successfully blocking attacks.
If active, armor will not lose durability from environmental sources like fire, lava, or falls.
gamerule.combat-penalty-remover.treat_ax: If active, axes and other tools will only lose 1 durability when used as a weapon, instead of the vanilla 2.
gamerule.combat-penalty-remover.prevent_: If active, attacks with low charge (below 90%) won't consume durability. Fixes tools breaking fast when spamming.
gamerule.combat-penalty-remover.attack_s: Percentage multiplier for attack recharge speed. 100 is vanilla, 200 is twice as fast, 50 is half speed.
gamerule.combat-penalty-remover.prevent_: If active, weapons won't lose durability when attacking other players.
If active, armor won't lose durability when damaged by other players.
modmenu.description.combat-penalty-remov: Removes durability penalties for weapons, armor, and shields via GameRules.
